text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I came to watch the "Tenno Sho (Spring)" 
together with Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The roaring cheers and the dignified 
running of the Mejiro family in response 
to them... It carried the presence of 
those who have continually borne 
expectations upon their shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin watched that scene. Feeling the 
gap between herself and Mejiro Ryan, she 
began to reflect on how to face the cheers 
of support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Can she become like Mejiro Ryan? To help 
her find that answer, let's build up her 
training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
